verdict.rationale: Before purchase, Firstbase's own pages name the filings it handles: annual reports and franchise tax reports, BOI filings, and foreign qualification. They state coverage of all 50 states and publish a $299 per state/year price on the registered-agent plan. It is not stated whether that price includes annual report and franchise tax filings, or whether state government fees are passed through, so total filing cost is unclear. Missing for 10: an explicit price tied to annual report/franchise tax filings, disclosure of state fees, a per-filing coverage breakdown by state, and independent confirmation of pricing transparency.
